parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch part of the electrical component, made of ABS plastic. It is the red actuator that toggles the electrical connection on or off.
parts.Functional_description: The switch allows the user to control the electrical circuit by pressing or flipping it, enabling or disabling current flow.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or pivotally within the base body to make or break the circuit connection.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the switch assembly, made of polycarbonate. It houses the electrical contacts and provides structural support for the switch mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the internal electrical connectors and provides a mounting frame for the switch, ensuring stability and insulation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed housing for the moving switch component.
